subject.title: fix(slack): opt-in flag to collapse assistant DM threads into base DM session

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-false Slack `channels.slack.dm.collapseAssistantThreads` option with narrow root/account inheritance as the supported fix for assistant-DM session fan-out?
rationale: The code path is understandable and proven at the routing layer, but adding a new Slack config/session contract and deciding whether collapse should be opt-in or default is maintainer product intent, not a purely mechanical bug-fix choice.

options.title: Accept Opt-In Contract After Cleanup
options.body: Rebase the PR, fix the stale wording, and land the default-false flag as the compatibility-preserving mitigation for affected Slack Agent/Assistant users.

options.title: Sponsor Default Collapse Instead
options.body: Pause this PR and replace it with a maintainer-owned change that collapses assistant DMs by default with any needed migration/docs proof.

options.title: Preserve Thread Isolation
options.body: Close or substantially narrow this branch if maintainers want Slack assistant threads to remain distinct OpenClaw sessions despite the reported DM UX impact.

recommendation.title: Accept Opt-In Contract After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, fix the stale wording, and land the default-false flag as the compatibility-preserving mitigation for affected Slack Agent/Assistant users.
